scripts.postinstall: cd worker && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.predev: npx --prefix worker wrangler whoami 2>&1 | grep -q 'not authenticated' && npx --prefix worker wrangler login || true
scripts.dev: concurrently -n worker,client -c blue,green "npm run dev:worker" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:window: concurrently -n worker,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix worker run dev:local" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.dev:window:r2: concurrently -n worker,client -c blue,green "npm --prefix worker run dev:remote-r2" "npm --prefix client start"
scripts.test: concurrently -n worker,client "npm run test:worker" "npm run test:client"
scripts.typecheck: concurrently -n worker,client "npm run typecheck:worker" "npm run typecheck:client"
